muther.boundary: Published mining-state audit and repository corpus mining are executable. MINE_REPO collects repository candidates before bounded selection, fingerprints superficially normalized snippets, suppresses exact copies, then applies a conservative character-shingle lexical-overlap guard before round-robin selection across path-derived source families. Near-duplicate suppression preserves an audit ledger instead of silently deleting provenance. This reduces repeated-copy pollution but remains deterministic lexical/structural handling, not semantic clustering, source-independence proof, source-quality scoring, novelty proof or truth judgment. Query-scoped Google Drive mining is executed by the authorized external connector runtime and handed back as redacted evidence. MINE_INTERNAL remains limited to explicit authorized query-scoped connector sources; it does not grant exhaustive private-environment crawling or cross-source enumeration. FALSIFY remains repository-scoped and absence is never upgraded to truth.

droplet.boundary: Published evidence audit and explicit-URL verification are executable. Search-engine discovery is executed by the external web connector runtime. VERIFY v1.2 computes SUPPORTED, REFUTED or INDETERMINATE over an explicit evidence bundle while suppressing exact replay amplification, counting caller-supplied source families as audit metadata, forcing INDETERMINATE on conflicting authoritative directions or contradictory use of one evidence fingerprint, and optionally enforcing a caller-supplied freshness policy. Under an active freshness policy, stale or undated evidence stays visible for audit but cannot create certainty. It does not infer whether a claim is time-sensitive, search the web by itself, prove source independence, score methodological quality, or treat absence of refutation as global truth.

gut.boundary: GUT v0.2.24 is a deterministic heuristic metabolic router. It preserves nutrient atoms, routes and provenance while applying bounded carry-rendering containment for inherited substrate, intra-atom and cross-segment echoes, volatile lineage, nested clauses, repeated route metadata and delimiter collisions. Machine-only hexadecimal ref/targetRef/clause/clauseRef identifiers are excluded from prose carry and preserved separately in a bounded carryRefs ledger with path, route, type and provenance, so referential continuity no longer depends on polluting semantic carry text. The verified VAJRA→GUT regression confirms targetRef continuity through carryRefs while the prose summary remains free of those machine tokens. These are deterministic structural normalization and routing rules, not semantic deletion, semantic novelty detection, semantic identity, source-truth judgment or proof that all metabolic echo is solved.

vajra.boundary: VAJRA retains proposition-aware dismantling, uncertainty/provenance preservation, contest persistence, multi-organ conflict-context routing, replay containment, content-bound history attestation and semantic-operator-preserving replay identity.
